title: Towards New Benchmark for AI Alignment & Sentiment Analysis in Socially Important Issues: A Comparative Study of Human and LLMs in the Context of AGI

bias_targets.methodology: Administering a 39-question, 5-point Likert scale survey to multiple LLMs to assess their attitudes towards Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), tracking temporal stability over consecutive days, and comparing the resulting sentiment scores against baselines established by human respondents.
